title: ETH gets locked in the `GroupcoinFactory` contract
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When we launch a Groupcoin to Uniswap v3, we intend to provide all the ETH received from sales as liquidity in the newly created Uniswap v3 pool.
